verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his Q+E combo blind before 6; you win by walling him off and outscaling after your Maiden comes online.

brief.thesis: Garen vs Yorick is a measured 50.8% over 1151 games, a genuinely even lane with a solo-kill edge in your favor. The deciding factor is W (Dark Procession): it hard-blocks movement rather than slowing, so it is the one tool Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) cannot cleanse, and landing it turns a 1v1 trade into a kill.

theirWindow.when: Q and E both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can dash in, silence you with Q, then follow with E (Judgment) for a full burst trade. Expect this combo and don't stand still for the auto after the dash; trade back knowing Q (Last Rites) heals you through it.

yourWindow.what: He has no gap-close or silence to escape or punish you. Land E (Mourning Mist) to mark and slow him, then wall behind with W (Dark Procession) so he can't walk out even if he pops Courage (W).

start.why: 49.1% win rate over 664 games. The extra sustain wins the auto-trade race against his passive Perseverance regen.

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.6% win rate over this page's sample. Sustained auto trades proc Grasp's heal every time, which directly counters his Perseverance regen race.

summoners.why: 50.5% win rate at 50.2% pick rate, the standard pick for this lane. Flash+Ignite (48.8%, 34.9% pick) is the alternative if you want to press your solo-kill advantage once R (Eulogy of the Isles) is up.

playing.title: Trade only after landing E
playing.detail: Mourning Mist reduces his armor and slows him before you commit to an extended trade, which beats his passive regen clock.

playing.title: Wall him before all-ins
playing.detail: W (Dark Procession) blocks movement outright, so unlike a slow it survives his Q (Decisive Strike) cleanse. Drop it behind him, not in front.

playing.title: Punish his Q cooldown
playing.detail: Decisive Strike is only 8 seconds. Track it and only avoid extended trades while it's up; the rest of the time he has no dash or silence.

playing.title: Deny his passive sustain
playing.detail: Keep landing Q (Last Rites) procs and autos on cooldown so he never gets a clean window to tick back health from Perseverance.

playing.title: Respect his R past level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice is a 400-range execute attempt on cooldowns of 140/110/80/50/20s. Don't overstay at low health once he's level 6, especially once it's near max rank.

playing.title: Shove waves with graves
playing.detail: Every champion/large-monster kill from Q (Last Rites) digs a grave; use the Mist Walkers that rise from it to push the wave for free plates instead of standing to trade.

playing.title: Win with Maiden split push
playing.detail: After level 6, R (Eulogy of the Isles) lets your attacks against the Maiden's target hit harder. Use that sidelane pressure to force him to answer or lose turrets.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup reading and trade timing are my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to contest lane while using your [W] to prevent Garen from closing in using (Q). Try to trap him inside [W] to deal damage if he is running low on health.
